card.name: The word immediately in instructions
card.fires_on: The word "immediate" or "immediately" (also the split-up capitals IMMEDIATELY) in label text, especially before "discontinue", "report" or "upon". It also fires weakly on a sentence-ending period after a technical description.

modes.label: Immediately before an action
modes.description: "Immediately" placed before a stop or report instruction, often at the start of a sentence.
modes.example: << Immediately>> discontinue estrogen-alone therapy if a stroke

modes.label: Immediate as a time adjective
modes.description: "Immediate" modifying a period such as the future or postoperative period.
modes.example: first tests on human beings are planned for the<< immediate>> future.

card.plain: It lights up on the word "immediately" when a label says to act right away or describes the immediate period.
